description: Extended 10-year (2016-2025) NEET UG verified PYQ & prep bank across Class 11 & 12 Biology, Chemistry, Physics.

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Which of the following are the smallest living cells known that completely lack a cell wall and can survive without oxygen?
questions.explanation: Mycoplasma completely lack a cell wall, are the smallest living cells known, and can survive without oxygen.
questions.source: NEET UG 2016 / NCERT Class 11 Biology Ch. 2

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: Which concentration term is independent of temperature?
questions.explanation: Molality (moles of solute per kg of solvent) depends only on mass, not volume, so it is independent of temperature.
questions.source: NEET UG 2016 / NCERT Class 11 Chemistry Ch. 1

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: For a projectile launched at angle θ with horizontal (neglecting air resistance), horizontal range R is maximum when θ equals:
questions.explanation: R = u² sin(2θ)/g is maximum when sin(2θ) = 1, i.e., 2θ = 90° → θ = 45°.
questions.source: NEET UG 2017 / NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch. 3

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Inhibition of succinic dehydrogenase by malonate is a classic example of:
questions.explanation: Malonate closely resembles the substrate succinate in structure and competes for the active site of succinic dehydrogenase.
questions.source: NEET UG 2017 / NCERT Class 11 Biology Ch. 9

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.chapter: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
questions.question: Which halogen has the highest negative electron gain enthalpy?
questions.explanation: Chlorine has a more negative electron gain enthalpy than Fluorine because F has very small 2p orbitals causing strong inter-electronic repulsion.
questions.source: NEET UG 2018 / NCERT Class 11 Chemistry Ch. 3

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: A typical mature angiosperm (Polygonum type) embryo sac is:
questions.explanation: A mature embryo sac has 3 antipodals, 1 central cell (2 polar nuclei), 2 synergids, and 1 egg cell = 7 cells and 8 nuclei.
questions.source: NEET UG 2018 / NCERT Class 12 Biology Ch. 1

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: In Young's double slit experiment, if the separation d between the two slits is halved and distance D to the screen is doubled, the fringe width β becomes:
questions.explanation: Fringe width β = λD/d. Making D → 2D and d → d/2 multiplies β by 2 / (1/2) = 4.
questions.source: NEET UG 2019 / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 10

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Statins, used as blood-cholesterol lowering agents, are commercially produced by the yeast:
questions.explanation: Monascus purpureus produces statins, which act by competitively inhibiting the enzyme responsible for cholesterol synthesis.
questions.source: NEET UG 2019 / NCERT Class 12 Biology Ch. 8

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: According to Bohr's model of the hydrogen atom, the energy of an electron in the nth orbit is proportional to:
questions.explanation: In Bohr's model, En = -13.6 / n² eV, so energy is inversely proportional to n².
questions.source: NEET UG 2020 / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 12

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: The palindrome recognition sequence for the restriction enzyme EcoRI is:
questions.explanation: EcoRI recognizes the 6-base-pair palindromic sequence 5'-GAATTC-3' and cuts between G and A.
questions.source: NEET UG 2020 / NCERT Class 12 Biology Ch. 9

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: Which alcohol gives immediate turbidity at room temperature with Lucas reagent (conc. HCl + anhydrous ZnCl2)?
questions.explanation: Tertiary alcohols form a stable 3° carbocation instantly, producing immediate turbidity with Lucas reagent.
questions.source: NEET UG 2021 / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 7

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: In a standard human ECG, the QRS complex represents:
questions.explanation: P-wave = atrial depolarisation, QRS complex = ventricular depolarisation, T-wave = ventricular repolarisation.
questions.source: NEET UG 2021 / NCERT Class 11 Biology Ch. 15

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: In vacuum, the speed of electromagnetic waves c is related to permeability μ₀ and permittivity ε₀ by:
questions.explanation: Maxwell showed c = 1/√(μ₀ε₀) ≈ 3 × 10⁸ m/s in vacuum.
questions.source: NEET UG 2022 / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 8

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Which plant hormone is widely known as the 'stress hormone' because it induces stomatal closure during drought?
questions.explanation: Abscisic acid (ABA) stimulates closure of stomata and increases plant tolerance to various stresses.
questions.source: NEET UG 2022 / NCERT Class 11 Biology Ch. 13

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: Which nitrogenous base is present in RNA but absent in DNA?
questions.explanation: DNA contains A, G, C, and Thymine (T), whereas RNA contains Uracil (U) instead of Thymine.
questions.source: NEET UG 2023 / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 10

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Which immunoglobulin is abundant in colostrum (mother's first milk) and provides passive immunity to newborns?
questions.explanation: Colostrum is rich in IgA antibodies, protecting the infant's mucosal surfaces during early life.
questions.source: NEET UG 2023 / NCERT Class 12 Biology Ch. 7

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: The nuclear radius R varies with mass number A as:
questions.explanation: Nuclear volume is proportional to A, so R = R₀ A^(1/3) where R₀ ≈ 1.2 × 10⁻¹⁵ m.
questions.source: NEET UG 2024 / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 13

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Among the 'Evil Quartet' of biodiversity loss, which is considered the single most important cause driving animals and plants to extinction?
questions.explanation: Habitat loss and fragmentation (e.g., tropical rainforest clearing) is the most important cause of species extinction.
questions.source: NEET UG 2024 / NCERT Class 12 Biology Ch. 13

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: In aqueous solution, the correct decreasing order of basic strength of methyl-substituted amines is:
questions.explanation: Due to combined +I effect, solvation (H-bonding), and steric hindrance in water, (CH3)2NH (2°) > CH3NH2 (1°) > (CH3)3N (3°).
questions.source: NEET UG 2025 / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 9

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: In Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium (p² + 2pq + q² = 1), the term 2pq represents the frequency of:
questions.explanation: p² = homozygous dominant (AA), q² = homozygous recessive (aa), and 2pq = heterozygous (Aa) individuals.
questions.source: NEET UG 2025 / NCERT Class 12 Biology Ch. 6

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Which part of the nephron is primarily responsible for conditional reabsorption of Na+ and water under the influence of ADH and aldosterone?
questions.explanation: Conditional reabsorption of Na+ and water takes place in the DCT (and collecting duct) regulated by aldosterone and ADH.
questions.source: NEET UG 2016 / NCERT Class 11 Biology Ch. 16

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: During skeletal muscle contraction, Ca²⁺ ions released from sarcoplasmic reticulum bind to:
questions.explanation: Calcium binds to a subunit of troponin on actin filaments, unmasking active sites for myosin cross-bridge formation.
questions.source: NEET UG 2017 / NCERT Class 11 Biology Ch. 17

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: During depolarisation of a neuron's axonal membrane, there is a rapid influx of:
questions.explanation: Opening of voltage-gated Na+ channels causes rapid influx of Na+, reversing membrane polarity (depolarisation).
questions.source: NEET UG 2018 / NCERT Class 11 Biology Ch. 18

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Which hormone acts on uterine smooth muscles and stimulates vigorous contractions during childbirth (parturition)?
questions.explanation: Oxytocin (released from posterior pituitary) triggers strong uterine contractions and milk ejection.
questions.source: NEET UG 2019 / NCERT Class 11 Biology Ch. 19

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Bt toxin protein produced by Bacillus thuringiensis kills bollworms because it becomes active in their:
questions.explanation: The inactive protoxin crystals are solubilized and activated in the alkaline pH of the insect midgut, creating pores in epithelial cells.
questions.source: NEET UG 2020 / NCERT Class 12 Biology Ch. 10

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: An ecological interaction where one species is harmed (-) and the other is unaffected (0) is called:
questions.explanation: Amensalism is (-, 0), such as Penicillium secreting penicillin that inhibits bacteria while remaining unaffected.
questions.source: NEET UG 2021 / NCERT Class 12 Biology Ch. 11

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: In aerobic cellular respiration, the final electron acceptor at the end of the mitochondrial Electron Transport System is:
questions.explanation: O2 acts as the final hydrogen/electron acceptor in Complex IV, combining with protons to form metabolic water.
questions.source: NEET UG 2022 / NCERT Class 11 Biology Ch. 12

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Which of the following is a hormone-releasing Intra Uterine Device (IUD)?
questions.explanation: Progestasert and LNG-20 are hormone-releasing IUDs; CuT and Multiload 375 are copper-releasing IUDs.
questions.source: NEET UG 2023 / NCERT Class 12 Biology Ch. 3

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Which group of plants is called the 'amphibians of the plant kingdom' because they live in soil but depend on water for sexual reproduction?
questions.explanation: Bryophytes (mosses and liverworts) grow on moist land but require water for flagellated antherozoids to reach the archegonium.
questions.source: NEET UG 2024 / NCERT Class 11 Biology Ch. 3

questions.subject: biology
questions.question: Presence of a pseudocoelom is a characteristic feature of which phylum?
questions.explanation: Aschelminthes are pseudocoelomates; Platyhelminthes are acoelomates, while Annelida to Chordata are true coelomates.
questions.source: NEET UG 2025 / NCERT Class 11 Biology Ch. 4
